items.name: vellum-theme
items.title: Vellum theme
items.description: Vellum design tokens: colours, field and control tokens, shadows, radius scale (light and dark).

items.name: account-menu
items.title: Account Menu
items.description: Avatar button that opens an account dropdown menu: user summary, "Manage account" and "Sign out", other signed-in accounts to switch to, "Add account" and an optional confirmed "Sign out of all accounts".

items.name: account-profile
items.title: Account Profile
items.description: Account settings panel with a sidebar nav and a Profile section (avatar and name, email addresses, linked sign-in accounts).

items.name: api-keys-card
items.title: Api Keys Card
items.description: API keys list with masked values, copy, revoke (with confirmation) and a create dialog that reveals the new secret once.

items.name: auth-page
items.title: Auth Page
items.description: Full-page auth layout: soft centered glow on the canvas, a centered card slot and a copyright/links footer.

items.name: auth-sign-in
items.title: Auth Sign In
items.description: Sign-in card: optional logo, provider buttons, email field, primary continue, an optional alternative method and a link to sign up.

items.name: auth-sign-up
items.title: Auth Sign Up
items.description: Sign-up card: optional logo, provider buttons, email and password (with show/hide), primary continue and a link to sign in.

items.name: auth-waitlist
items.title: Auth Waitlist
items.description: Waitlist card: email field and a join button, swapping to a confirmation once submitted.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Full-width notice strip for page or section state (trial ending, sending paused, verification needed).

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: Inline notice for page-level context ("Use this sandbox for test data; switch to live when you're ready.").

items.name: create-user-dialog
items.title: Create User Dialog
items.description: "Create new user" dialog with Create / Invite tabs, optional name fields, password visibility toggle and inline validation.

items.name: create-wizard
items.title: Create Wizard
items.description: Two-step create flow (type cards and name, then toggleable options) with a live preview on the right.

items.name: cta-section
items.title: Cta Section
items.description: Closing call-to-action card: title, short pitch and actions over soft line art.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.title: Dashboard Shell
items.description: Dashboard chrome: workspace, application and environment menus, header actions and the primary tab nav above the page content.

items.name: data-table-card
items.title: Data Table Card
items.description: Data table card with search, column visibility, filters, sortable headers, row actions and empty states.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Popover date-range picker with relative presets, From/To date-time rows and a range calendar.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Centered empty state: icon tile, title, supporting copy and optional actions.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: Faq Section
items.description: FAQ section: title on the left, accordion of questions on the right.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: Feature section: eyebrow, title and body, a bento grid of feature cards, and an optional badge row.

items.name: feature-upsell
items.title: Feature Upsell
items.description: "Turn on a feature" panel: a feature carousel with illustrations and an enable button, which swaps to an empty state with a turn-off action once enabled.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: Filter toolbar: removable filter pills and "Clear all" on wider screens, a filter sheet on phones, with leading and trailing slots for navigation and actions (date range, refresh, share).

items.name: hero-section
items.title: Hero Section
items.description: Marketing hero: headline, supporting copy, a primary CTA beside a copy-to-clipboard pill, and an optional logo cloud.

items.name: integration-cards
items.title: Integration Cards
items.description: Responsive grid of integration cards with an optional "request an integration" callout.

items.name: invite-member-dialog
items.title: Invite Member Dialog
items.description: Invite-member dialog: email and role fields with inline validation, Cancel / Invite footer.

items.name: members-card
items.title: Members Card
items.description: Workspace members: Members/Invitations tabs, search, invite dialog, and a table with per-member role select and an actions menu.

items.name: pricing-plans
items.title: Pricing Plans
items.description: Pricing section: title, monthly/annual toggle and a responsive grid of plan cards.

items.name: settings-card
items.title: Settings Card
items.description: Settings card: a switch-led header (title, description, optional badge) over a white panel of option rows that collapses while off.

items.name: settings-sidebar
items.title: Settings Sidebar
items.description: Desktop settings sidebar: a "Find…" box that opens the find dialog above the grouped, collapsible settings navigation.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site Footer
items.description: Marketing footer: framed logo, link columns, social links and a legal line.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.description: Floating sticky marketing header: optional announcement bar, logo slot, mega-menu navigation, sign-in/sign-up actions and a phone menu.

items.name: testimonials-section
items.title: Testimonials Section
items.description: Testimonials: heading, an optional action, a rotating featured quote and a grid of quote cards.

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace Switcher
items.description: Workspace switcher: a compact trigger showing the active workspace that opens a dropdown menu.

items.name: vellum-skill
items.title: Vellum skill
items.description: Agent skill: how to build UI with Vellum (setup, variants, composition, styling rules).

items.name: vellum-design
items.title: Vellum DESIGN.md
items.description: The Vellum design spec (tokens, elevation, shapes, variant rules, do's and don'ts).
